architecture.reason: Existing public marketing layer and authenticated Xroga Connect plugin marketplace are preserved, without a second integration runtime or credential path.

rollout: Preview environment only after checks. Never merge, promote, or reassign xroga.com domain without a separate explicit production approval.
rollback: Discard the branch or revert its /integrations UI/data/stylesheet/test/manifest files; production main unaffected.
knownGaps: 711 is the static build technology catalog count as of this branch; it is NOT 711 authorized, live provider connectors, 2,000+ live connectors, 3,000+, or unlimited integrations.
Auth scheme and real tools/triggers are discovered on authenticated detail; public cards never claim an exact count or an already-connected account.
Custom MCP links to existing /dashboard/integrations?view=custom and depends on runtime configuration, security checks and supported server compatibility.
Brand images use existing external Simple Icons mappings and fall back to letters where unsupported.
No real browser screenshot or deployment is claimed until a verified exact-commit preview exists.
Repository-wide CI contains historical mission-policy and inventory checks unrelated to this scoped UI; must not bypass.
Full interactive search/keyboard/breakpoint checks require actual browser preview.
External agents are not directly integrated into Xroga as connected providers. Their visible 'GitHub handoff' workflow reuses the separately authorized repo, with each provider's independent access.
24/7 automation is a potential supported workflow category, not a claim that every integration runs continuously; scheduler support and provider availability require validation per task.

blockers: Exact latest frontend build and non-production Vercel READY deployment are required for visual review.
Existing repository-wide failing policy/inventory checks are not passed or bypassed.
No merge or production release without separate owner approval.
